# upload-progress-label

percentLabel(fraction) receives a finite number in [0,1] and returns an integer percentage followed immediately by %. Convert the fraction to percent before rounding with Math.round. No spaces, decimal places or zero padding are added.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Preserve the public API and existing tests. Use only Node built-ins; no dependencies or network access.
